title: Memorial shelf for ArcanaObscura (Disembarking, pressure door scene)
dedication: In memory of ArcanaObscura. Fly peacefully into the night.
placement: scripts/author-shuttle-scenes.mjs (MEMORIAL_ICON and the memorial block), where the boarding checklist hung

source.what: The server emoji :mikmoff:, added by the community to remember her
source.suppliedBy: The owner, 24 October 2026, who asked for the icon to be pulled and used

derivation: Cropped to the drawn 20x18 pixels; box-sampled to 12x12; each pixel the nearest Activity scene palette colour; pairs of pixel rows drawn as half-block characters, one colour a cell (where two pixels differ, the eye and highlights win over the cloak and outline). No model or image tool.

provenance.author: Arranged by the coding agent (Claude) at owner direction
